summary: Implemented and passed a bounded MZ73 smoke test of the MatRIS-primary restrained-precondition/release ML-NEB executor with AQCat25 exact fixed-path secondary evaluation; no production GPU or VASP job was submitted.

payload.objective: Prepare the hash-bound production dual-model GPU path request for Fe(110) C2HO* + H* -> C2H2O* + * and obtain explicit user authorization before submission.
current_evidence: The dual-model executor and wrapper are implemented. Local Ruff, Python compilation, shell syntax, focused ML-NEB tests, and execution-backend tests pass.
MZ73 smoke job 1317 has a successful producer exit record and is absent from the live queue; MZ73 still lacks durable terminal Slurm accounting.

The nine-image smoke ran two restrained MatRIS preconditioning steps, removed every temporary internal-coordinate restraint, ran two unrestrained ordinary MatRIS ML-NEB steps, and evaluated AQCat25 on the exact returned structure hashes without relaxation.

The returned smoke path preserves the fixed mask and periodic branch, has C1-C2 distances of 1.4161-1.4547 A, retains images 04-06 in the forming O-H 1.1-1.8 A interval, and has maximum adjacent mobile-atom RMSD 0.3505 A.
The smoke is intentionally unconverged after two steps per stage. It validates the executor chain only and is not a production path, DIMER parent, VASP result, TS, or barrier.
No production GPU path or VASP job was submitted.
